title: Strong Solutions to SDEs with Supercritical Drift Arising in Navigation Problems
summary: We prove strong existence and pathwise uniqueness for two stochastic models of a seeker steering toward a target, written in polar coordinates. In both, the angular drift carries a $\frac1{r}$-type singularity which belongs to the supercritical regime in $\mathbb{R}^2$. Standard results for SDEs with singular drift therefore do not apply, and we give a new proof of strong well-posedness based on a pathwise argument.
